subject: Marketplace co-sell: invoice routing, withholding tax, and W-8/W-9 playbook

Subject: Question: How will invoicing and tax be handled for AWS marketplace purchase?

Hi Priya,

We're almost across the finish line on the PO for the co-sell purchase (Logistry x Redwood via AWS Marketplace), but our procurement team flagged two items they need clarified before payment:

1) Who will issue the invoice we need for our AP/Tax team? Will AWS bill us directly, or does Redwood provide a vendor invoice?
2) For US tax compliance, do you require a W-9 or W-8BEN-E from us? Our finance is in the US but we have an EU subsidiary involved.
3) VAT / reverse-charge: since some seats will be billed to our EU entity, will Redwood produce VAT invoices or does AWS handle VAT in the Marketplace?

They asked for an example invoice flow and any documentation from your side or from AWS/GCP to attach to the PO. Can you loop in the right people and advise next steps?

Thanks,

Logistry Inc.

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Karthik (marketplace billing) and Marissa (partner ops) to confirm the exact flows across AWS/GCP/Azure and the documentation. Quick summary up front so procurement can move:

- Short answer: It depends on the marketplace and the chosen commercial model (AWS Vendor Direct, AWS Marketplace SaaS with customer billed by AWS, or co-sell reseller). We will map Logistry's selected SKU to the appropriate flow.
- W-9 vs W-8: If Logistry is a US-payee entity, we typically collect a W-9. If non-US, we collect the appropriate W-8 form.
- VAT: For EU-billed seats, if Redwood is the supplier on the invoice we will issue VAT invoices (include VAT number). If the marketplace (AWS/GCP) is the billing party, they often collect VAT and issue the invoice — in that case your AP would receive AWS/GCP tax docs.

I've attached our latest Marketplace-Invoicing-Playbook (summary sheet in the workbook) and a mapping that shows who issues the invoice by marketplace/model. Karthik — can you confirm the recommended paperwork for Logistry specifically and flag any region-specific withholding concerns (APAC)?

Next steps:
- Karthik: confirm flow and which legal entity will appear on the invoice for DEAL-7892.
- Emma/Logistry: send the legal entity name and tax jurisdiction for the seat(s) being billed.
- Priya/Marissa: we will prepare an example invoice PDF tailored to your PO and indicate whether AWS or Redwood will be the invoicing party.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, finance@logistry.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-13T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: How will invoicing and tax be handled for AWS marketplace purchase?

Hi all — quick breakdown by marketplace and co-sell model (keeping it high level):

AWS Marketplace
- "AWS Customer-Billed (AWS invoices)": AWS bills the customer, collects tax where applicable, and remits to the customer. Redwood receives settlement reports from AWS. Invoices to the customer come from AWS; Redwood can provide supporting settlement/usage reports on request. For these purchases AWS typically requires the vendor to be registered in AWS Marketplace and to accept their terms.
- "AWS Reseller / Co-sell (ISV + AWS Marketplace)": In many reseller flows AWS or the reseller issues the invoice and handles tax collection. Redwood may need to issue a secondary invoice/credit note depending on the accounting treatment in the customer's jurisdiction — we outlined this in the attached AWS-Reseller-Flow.pdf. W-9/W-8 handling: if you (Logistry) are the payee to Redwood (not AWS), we collect W-9 for US entities; otherwise we request W-8 series for non-US.

GCP Marketplace
- GCP often supports both direct billing by Google and partner-billed models. If Google invoices, they will apply VAT or GST per local rules. If Redwood invoices, we will include VAT number and reverse-charge references when appropriate.

Azure Marketplace
- Similar split: Microsoft may invoice and collect tax, or the ISV invoices directly depending on the commercial contract.

Region/Withholding notes
- APAC: some jurisdictions (India, Philippines) have withholding tax rules for certain services; if your legal entity is in APAC we may need to gross-up or supply tax treaty documentation.
- EU VAT: if your EU subsidiary is purchasing, supply the EU VAT ID so we can issue a proper VAT invoice with reverse-charge references when applicable.

Practical recommendation for Logistry (DEAL-7892):
1) Please confirm the exact paying entity name(s), billing address(es), and tax IDs for each seat (US entity vs EU subsidiary).
2) If Logistry will pay AWS directly (AWS invoices), confirm that so we can provide settlement reports and a statement of work to attach to your PO.
3) If Redwood will be the invoice party, please e-sign the W-9 (if US) or provide the appropriate W-8 and we will issue the vendor invoice with VAT where required.

I've attached a short checklist and the reseller flow diagram. Marissa — I recommend we prepare two example invoices: one showing AWS as invoicer and one showing Redwood as invoicer, plus a short note on accounting treatment (credit memos). Aditya: please confirm any changes needed in our billing team for issuing credits to customers when AWS is the primary invoicer.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Marketplace Billing, Redwood Inference

From: aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com

Date: 2026-07-14T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoicing for Logistry — confirmation and portal links

Hi Priya and Emma,

Thanks for the RFC. Confirming the standard behaviors on AWS Marketplace for co-sell:

- If the transaction is set up as AWS-billed ("AWS invoices the customer"), AWS will issue the commercial invoice and collect applicable VAT/GST. Customers will find invoices in their AWS billing console.
- For vendor-billed models, the ISV (Redwood) invoices the customer and must include the correct tax registration details.
- For reseller/co-sell cases, the marketplace listing and contract determines who is the billing party. We can confirm the setting for the Logistry SKU if you provide the marketplace listing ID.

Helpful links:
- Partner billing portal: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/managed/billing-portal (see partner > invoicing)
- Doc: How tax is applied on AWS Marketplace (internal link): https://partner-docs.aws/marketplace/tax

If you want, we can toggle the listing to a vendor-billed vs AWS-billed flow for testing in your staging account — we'll need the listing ID and confirmation from Redwood's partner manager.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Ops
(automated response queue)
